name: Quick Notes
author: ghpo
description: Quick note button + dialog with optional encrypted storage (XChaCha20-Poly1305 + Argon2id), recent-notes list, search, #tags, delete confirmation, change-password re-encryption, and git sync to a private remote

barWidget.description: Button that opens the quick note dialog

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Glyph shown on the bar button

schema.label: Encrypt notes
schema.description: Encrypt all notes at rest (password asked on first use; key stays in memory until Lock)

schema.label: Git remote (SSH URL)
schema.description: Optional private git remote to sync the notes to (e.g. git@github.com:user/notes.git). Empty = no sync.
